decision: The modern spinner standalone conversion adds NgTemplateOutlet and changes module, fixture and guard metadata. Retain the owned spinner declaration, two selectors and same-class alias. The public peer options token and types remain delegated while the defaults factory is locally owned; this does not establish modern component inheritance.

No template, selector, animation implementation or stylesheet hunk in the original change.
prior_individual_review.current_floor_and_legacy_impact: MatLegacyProgressSpinner is its own standalone:false component; legacy module declares and exports it and imports CommonModule plus legacy common. MatLegacySpinner is the same owned class object and both historical selectors remain; its SVG circle template and keyframe lifecycle are owned, not current modern spinner template. Public legacy options token aliases the current 22.1.7 token; local historical defaults factory remains owned. Packed JIT verifies module, alias, selectors, token identity and modern peer standalone metadata.
prior_individual_review.proof_gaps_and_next: Separate native AOT/browser motion+style work must test determinate/indeterminate switching, SVG circle, style insertion/removal, diameter/stroke changes, noop mode and destruction; the current metadata probe cannot certify animation lifecycle, style equivalence, CSP behavior or rendering.
